description: Fixes applied at the edge on the user's own Cloudflare, on any CMS. Pick with mode: rules = One Worker that fixes a whole section by rules. Needs audit_id. prerender = Serve rendered HTML to AI crawlers for JavaScript apps. Needs url.

audit_id.description: Id of a completed site audit (start_site_audit, then get_site_audit until complete).

site_name.description: Brand name for title endings, for example 'Acme Shoes'.

url.description: A page of the app, for example https://app.example.com/pricing.

name: edge_worker
title: Cloudflare Workers
